entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandre Michaud, count of Beauretour was a Piedmontese general who served in the Imperial Russian Army as aide de camp to the tsar and as a military commander. His father was Jean-François Michaud, chief engineer to the County of Nice. He is buried in a floor tomb in the Catacombe dei Cappuccini.
